---
title: "PRC Data Challenge 2026"
---

The \acr{PRC} with the support of [\acr{OSN}](https://opensky-network.org/)
aims at engaging with data scientists to team up and compete to solve a
(big-ish) Data Challenge of interest to the wider Aviation community

1. using open data
1. openly sharing final solutions (code and documentation on public GitHub repo)
1. publishing an open access paper on [\acr{JOAS}](https://journals.open.tudelft.nl/joas/)

![](media/PRC-Data-challenge-1080x1080.jpg){width="540px" height="auto" alt="PRC Data Challenge"}

The 2026 edition of the \acr{PRC} Data Challenge proposes to predict the
**taxi-out time** of flights from 11 major European airports.
The learning dataset will consist of all airport movements for the full year 2025.

Ranking will use \acr{RMSE} for the submitted prediction for the movements in
Jan and Jul 2026.

The competition runs from $1^{st}$ Sep till $11^{th}$ Oct 2026 23:59:59 CET.  
The total prize amount for the first 3 teams is 5000 EUR.  

Check the conditions for [eligibility for participation & prize](eligibility.qmd)
and then fill the following team creation request form!\

:::{.container .text-center}
[Request Team Creation!](https://example.com){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg role="button" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Request Team Creation" target="_blank"}  
[(The participation is open to all but teams from sanctioned countries are excluded.)]{.small }
:::


::: {.callout-warning title="Attention"}
Your request will be assessed and eventually approved.   
You will then receive a **verification email** and, on successful reply,
the relevant access keys to the datasets/buckets.
:::
